shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' | head -200"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- index.html ---\\n' && cat index.html"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 3 -type f \\( -name 'INDEX.md' -o -name 'README.md' \\) | sort | head -50; echo '---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo '---dist---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head"

/bin/bash -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version\"; printf '\\n--- installed @gravity-ui pkgs ---\\n'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; printf '\\n--- uikit d.ts components with relevant names ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -type f -name '*.d.ts' | rg -i 'Avatar|Select|Checkbox|Switch|Button|Text|User|Label|File|Upload' | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in Button Select Checkbox Switch Avatar Text TextInput ControlLabel; do p=$(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components -type d -name "$f" | head -1); echo "===== $f ====="; find "$p" -maxdepth 1 -name '"'*.d.ts' -print -exec sed -n '1,160p' {} \\; 2>/dev/null | head -220; done"

/bin/bash -lc "npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -40; echo '--- peer latest ---'; npm view @gravity-ui/components@latest peerDependencies dependencies --json 2>/dev/null; echo '--- versions recent ---'; npm view @gravity-ui/components version"

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in Switch Checkbox Select Avatar; do p=$(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components -type d -name "$f" | head -1); echo "===== $f ====="; find "$p" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '"'*.d.ts' | sort | while read d; do echo \"--- "'$d ---"; sed -n '"'1,140p' \""'$d"; done; done'

/bin/bash -lc "echo '--- useFileInput ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs -type f -name 'useFileInput*.d.ts' -exec sh -c 'echo ---"'$1---; cat "$1"'"' _ {} \\;; echo '--- FileDropZone types ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/lab/FileDropZone -name '*.d.ts' -maxdepth 2 | sort | while read d; do echo \"--- "'$d ---"; sed -n '"'1,140p' \""'$d"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "echo '--- Select types ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Select/types.d.ts; echo '--- ControlProps ---'; rg -n \"ControlProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo '--- Flex/Box exports ---'; rg -n \"export.*(Flex|Box|sp|spacing)\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/layout -g '*.d.ts' | head -40; echo '--- uikit index exports ---'; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/index.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.24.1 peerDependencies dependencies --json'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | sed -n '1,40p'; echo '--- check available icons ---'; for icon in Gear Envelope CircleCheck CircleX ClockGear; do f="'$(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons -type f -name "$icon.d.ts" -o -name "$icon.js" | head -1); echo "$icon -> ${f:-NOT FOUND}"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components -maxdepth 2 -type d | rg -i 'form|label|control|field|input' | sort; echo '--- index export form ---'; rg -n -i \"Form|Field\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/index.d.ts | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "echo '--- Flex d.ts ---'; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; echo '--- Box d.ts ---'; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts; echo '--- ControlProps full ---'; sed -n '1,30p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/types.d.ts; echo '--- ControlGroupOption ---'; rg -n \"ControlGroupOption\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'for icon in Globe GlobeRu Envelope CircleCheck CircleCheckFill CircleInfo Info Bolt TriangleExclamation Calendar; do f=$(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm -maxdepth 1 -name "$icon.js" | head -1); echo "$icon -> ${f:-NOT FOUND}"; done; echo '"'--- all icons count ---'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm | wc -l; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm | rg -i 'globe|envelop|check|notif|bell|alert|clock|time|language|translate|gear' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc "echo '--- components index exports ---'; rg -n \"export \\*|export \\{\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/index.d.ts | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "echo '--- Text ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Text/Text.d.ts; echo '--- Text types ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Text -name '*.d.ts' | while read d; do echo \"### "'$d"; sed -n '"'1,120p' \""'$d"; done; echo '"'--- Card ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Card -maxdepth 2 -name '*.d.ts' | sort | while read d; do echo \"### "'$d"; sed -n '"'1,140p' \""'$d"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "echo '--- hooks index ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/hooks/index.d.ts; echo '--- package exports ---'; node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({main:p.main,module:p.module,exports:p.exports,types:p.types},null,2))\""

/bin/bash -lc 'for icon in Person Camera ArrowUpFromLine Globe Envelope ShieldCheck Bell CircleCheck CircleCheckFill; do f=$(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm -maxdepth 1 -name "$icon.js" | head -1); echo "$icon -> ${f:-NOT FOUND}"; done; echo '"'--- Label d.ts ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Label -maxdepth 2 -name '*.d.ts' | sort | while read d; do echo \"### "'$d"; sed -n '"'1,100p' \""'$d"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/utils/configure -name '*.d.ts' | while read d; do echo \"### "'$d"; cat "$d"; done; echo '"'--- i18n configure in index ---'; rg -n \"configure|Lang\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/utils/configure -g '*.d.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "echo '--- layout spacing types ---'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/layout/types.d.ts; echo '--- spacing types ---'; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/layout/spacing/spacing.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -type f -name 'configure*' -o -path '*configure*' | head -30; echo '---'; rg -n \"export .*configure|declare.*configure|enum Lang|type Lang\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs -g '*.d.ts' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/utils/configure.d.ts; echo '--- Config dts ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs -name '*.d.ts' | xargs rg -n \"interface Config|type Config\" | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Icon -maxdepth 2 -name '*.d.ts' | sort | while read d; do echo \"### "'$d"; sed -n '"'1,120p' \""'$d"; done'
/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json; echo '--- vite ---'; cat vite.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"Select|options|value|onUpdate|Option\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60; echo '--- README form section? ---'; rg -n -i \"Checkbox|Switch|Select|TextInput|Avatar|useFileInput\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7.43.0/llms.txt | rg -n -A 30 -B 2 "Select" | head -120'

/bin/bash -lc "echo '--- esm index avatar/select/switch exports ---'; rg -n \"Avatar|Select|Switch|Checkbox|useFileInput|configure|Lang\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -40; echo '--- icons package type ---'; sed -n '1,40p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/Gear.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '--- icons esm Gear head ---'; sed -n '1,20p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm/Gear.js"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/index.d.ts; echo '--- esm index content ---'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts; echo '--- cjs components exports sample ---'; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.js"
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Select/index.d.ts; echo '--- tech components ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Select -name 'tech-components*' -maxdepth 1 -print -exec cat {} \\;"

/bin/bash -lc "cd /home/sandbox/workspace && perl -0pi -e \"s/import \\{ArrowUpFromLine, Bell, CircleCheck, Envelope, Globe, Person, ShieldCheck\\} from '\\@gravity-ui\\/icons';/import {ArrowUpFromLine, CircleCheck, Person} from '\\@gravity-ui\\/icons';/\" src/ProfileSettingsPage.tsx
perl -0pi -e 's/const LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = \\[([\\s\\S]*?)\\] as const;/const LANGUAGE_OPTIONS = ["'$1];/'"' src/ProfileSettingsPage.tsx
perl -0pi -e 's/const TIME_ZONE_OPTIONS = \\[([\\s\\S]*?)\\] as const;/const TIME_ZONE_OPTIONS = ["'$1];/'"' src/ProfileSettingsPage.tsx
echo '--- imports/options ---'; sed -n '1,45p' src/ProfileSettingsPage.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1'
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1'
